name: stock-api
description: Example adapter: a GraphQL subgraph in front of a REST API, written from its OpenAPI contract. It calls the address in STOCK_API_URL, here the stock-rest brick; for your own service, change that address and the adapter's code. The router checks the token (D19); this example neither checks it again nor passes it to the REST API. Its source is apis/stock-api; build the image with: docker build -t ghcr.io/rudney5000/plugbricks/stock-api:0.1.0 apis/stock-api

dependencies.description: the REST API the adapter calls; point STOCK_API_URL at your own service and drop this dependency
